title: UN Charter takes effect
body:
The world had just survived its deadliest war. On this day, a new organization was built to stop the next one.

24 October 1945. The United Nations Charter took effect, once China, France, the Soviet Union, the United Kingdom, and the United States had ratified it, along with a majority of the other signers.

Fifty nations had signed the Charter in San Francisco that June. Poland, not represented at the conference, signed in October, making 51 founding members. Its opening words still echo: "We the peoples of the United Nations."

The League of Nations had failed to stop the road to war in the 1930s. The UN was designed with a stronger Security Council and a permanent seat for each of the great powers that won the war.

October 24 is still marked every year as United Nations Day.
